[e002:f10] Learn More Masayoshi Son wants more OpenAI, and SoftBank is turning to the junk-bond market to help finance it. [e002:f11] SoftBank Group has launched a $10 billion dollar-denominated bond sale and a €1 billion (approximately $1.15 billion) euro-denominated offering, with proceeds set to help fund the Japanese conglomerate’s next $10 billion investment in OpenAI. [e002:f12] The senior unsecured notes are divided across five maturities: 3.5, 5.5 and 7.5 years for the dollar bonds, and four and six years for the euro notes, according to a term sheet cited by Reuters. [e002:f13] The bonds are expected to price Sept. [e002:f15] The financing will support the third tranche of SoftBank’s follow-on OpenAI investment , which is expected to close Oct. [e002:f16] The bond proceeds will also be used for general corporate purposes, while SoftBank plans to cancel all or part of the undrawn capacity under a separate 2026 bridge loan facility.

evidence.body: [e001:f01] 6月25日の定時株主総会と7月1日の臨時取締役会を経て正式決定する。 [e001:f02] 井上氏はホンダの欧州や中国の責任者などを経て、電動事業開発部門のトップ、昨年4月には四輪事業本部長に就いたが、6月にホンダの取締役退任が決まっていた。 [e001:f03] ホンダは日立が保有するアステモの株式21％分を取得し、出資比率を61％に引き上げて子会社化する予定でいる。 [e001:f04] 電気自動車（EV）戦略の失敗で業績が悪化している同社は、ソフトウエア・デファインド・ビークル（SDV）やハイブリッド車（HV）に重点を置く方針に軌道修正した。 [e001:f05] アステモはSDVや電動車向けを含むパワートレイン技術に強い。 [e001:f06] ホンダはアステモの先進技術や開発力を高く評価しており、連携を強化する。 [e001:f07] 今回、ホンダの四輪事業部門で実務経験の長い井上氏にトップ交代することで、ホンダの四輪事業の立て直しについて、系列サプライヤーとして全面的に支える体制を整える。 [e001:f08] 竹内社長もホンダ出身で、2023年7月にアステモの社長に就いた。 [e001:f09] ホンダでは財務・管理部門が長く、アステモでは前任社長時代の品質問題を踏まえた対応や財務体質の改善、株式公開に向けた準備などを担ってきた。 [e001:f10] 井上勝史氏（いのうえ・かつし）1986年3月、横浜国立大学経営学部卒、同年4月ホンダ入社。 [e001:f11] 2015年ホンダカーズインディア社長、16年ホンダ執行役員、欧州地域本部長、20年常務執行役員兼中国本部長兼本田技研工業（中国）投資総経理兼本田技研科技（中国）総経理、23年執行役専務兼電動事業開発本部長、25年取締役執行役専務兼四輪事業本部長兼リスクマネジメントオフィサー、25年6月同取締役執行役専務、26年4月同取締役。

evidence.title: BREAKING: Honda QC3 Launched: Can This Electric Scooter Change Honda’s EV Game?
evidence.body: [e002:f01] Honda takes another shot at cracking the family EV market Quick Read: Gets a 3 kWh battery pack and a claimed range of 145 km Comes in 4 colour options Priced at Rs 1,35,000 (ex-showroom, Delhi) Looks like Honda has decided to give the electric family-oriented scooter story a second try. [e002:f02] After the QC1 and Activa e: failed to make a significant mark in the market, Honda is hoping to turn the tide with the new QC3 electric scooter. [e002:f03] Priced at Rs 1,35,000 (ex-showroom, Delhi), the QC3 is aimed squarely at families and everyday urban riders. [e002:f04] Here’s everything you need to know about Honda’s latest electric offering: Design The Honda QC3 follows the familiar silhouette of the QC1 but gets a few changes to make it stand out. [e002:f05] The scooter will be available in four colour options: Matt Photon Gray Metallic, Pearl Precious White, Pearl Shallow Blue and Pearl Siren Blue. [e002:f06] Battery & Range Powering the QC3 is a 3.0 kWh battery pack, which gives the Honda scooter a claimed certified IDC (Indian Driving Cycle) range of 145 km. [e002:f07] Charging from zero to 80 percent takes 2 hours and 40 minutes, while a full charge takes approximately four hours. [e002:f08] Underpinnings The QC3 gets a conventional electric scooter underpinnings setup, with the battery positioned under the floorboard. [e002:f09] The QC3 gets 32 litres of underseat storage space, which should be enough for carrying everyday essentials and add to its family-friendly appeal. [e002:f10] Features The scooter also gets a 5-inch TFT console. [e002:f11] ZigSays With the QC3, Honda appears to be taking a more practical approach to the growing electric scooter segment. [e002:f12] Instead of trying to make an electric scooter that feels radically different, the QC3 focuses on the things that matter to family buyers: usable range, storage, connected features and convenient charging. [e002:f13] But at Rs 1.35 lakh (ex-showroom, Delhi), the QC3 enters a competitive segment. [e002:f14] After the relatively muted response to Honda's earlier electric offerings, the QC3 will have to get the basics right (it at least does on paper) to turn the tide in Honda's favour. [e002:f15] All said and done, Honda has yet to reveal the detailed specifications of the electric scooter. [e002:f16] The QC3 will initially be sold in Delhi, Agra, Cuttack, Surat and Kollam through select authorised Honda RedWing dealerships.

evidence.title: FIA launches Azerbaijan Grand Prix investigation after Baku FP1 incident
evidence.body: [e004:f01] Bottas was classified in 22nd place in the opening practice session in Baku as Mercedes driver George Russell set the pace. [e004:f02] Valtteri Bottas under FIA investigation at Azerbaijan Grand Prix The Finnish driver’s fastest time was almost two seconds slower than the Aston Martin of Lance Stroll in 21st. [e004:f03] Bottas has found himself under investigation by the FIA stewards after FP1 for allegedly overtaking under yellow flags during the session. [e004:f04] Bottas and a Cadillac team representative are required to report to the stewards at 13:50 local time in Baku. [e004:f05] Valtteri Bottas vs Sergio Perez: Cadillac head-to-head stats for F1 2026 season F1 2026: Head-to-head qualifying statistics between teammates F1 2026: Head-to-head race statistics between teammates Bottas’s summons comes after an eventful opening practice session in Azerbaijan. [e004:f06] A number of drivers – including Red Bull pair Max Verstappen and Isack Hadjar, as well as Oscar Piastri and Alex Albon – reported pulling under braking in the early stages of the session. [e004:f07] The brakes of Albon’s Williams teammate Carlos Sainz caught fire in the pit lane, with Hadjar sidelined after reporting a “broken engine” over team radio. [e004:f08] Mercedes driver and F1 2026 championship leader Kimi Antonelli stopped after reporting a hydraulics issue over team radio. [e004:f09] Meanwhile, the McLaren pair of Piastri and reigning world champion Lando Norris were also left in the garage for long stretches of the session after the upgraded MCL40s sustained damage. [e004:f10] Cadillac remains the only team yet to score a point in the F1 2026 season entering the Azerbaijan Grand Prix. [e004:f11] Bottas claimed the team’s best result by finishing 13th at the second race in China in March. [e004:f12] Cadillac’s poor results and patchy reliability record led to the team parting ways with team principal Graeme Lowdon during the summer break. [e004:f13] Lowdon was replaced by Marcin Budkowski, the former Renault/Alpine executive. evidence.title: 復帰のハジャー、骨折を明かす「自然に治るのを待って時間がかかった」契約延長は詳細語らず／F1第15戦水曜会見
evidence.body: [e003:f01] 今回も角田裕毅の出場が期待されていただけに、日本人ファンにとっては少し残念ではある。 [e003:f02] しかし復帰は、素直に祝福すべきだろう。 [e003:f03] 水曜日に行われたFIAの会見のパート1には、ハジャーの他にシャルル・ルクレール（フェラーリ）、アレクサンダー・アルボン（ウイリアムズ）が出席した。 [e003:f04] 【写真】2026年F1第15戦アゼルバイジャンGP FIA会見 左からアイザック・ハジャー（レッドブル）、シャルル・ルクレール（フェラーリ）、アレクサンダー・アルボン（ウイリアムズ） Q：ケガについて、ふたつ質問があります。 [e003:f05] ハジャー：「手首の外側に小さな骨折があったんだ。 [e003:f06] 手術は必要なかったから、自然に治るのを待つ形で時間がかかった。 [e003:f07] しかしここでは、骨折したこと、回復までの経過は言及したものの、何をしてケガをしたのか、答えはなかった。 [e003:f08] では延長された契約は、どんな内容だったのか。 [e003:f09] 1年契約なのか、複数年契約なのか教えてください。 [e003:f10] ハジャー：「僕自身は何も話していない。 [e003:f11] 交渉は周りの人たちに任せて、僕はコース上で結果を出す。 [e003:f12] それだけだよ」 何年契約か、まさか知らないはずはないのだが。 [e003:f13] ちなみにハジャーに限らず、F1ドライバーは契約の際、やってはいけないスポーツや、細かい制限事項が決められているものだ。 [e003:f14] 禁止されているというわけではないけど、それほど安全なスポーツではないから」 アルボン：「同じだね。 [e003:f15] [オートスポーツweb 2026年09月24日] 【関連記事】 2026年F1第15戦アゼルバイジャンGP（土曜決勝）TV放送＆タイムスケジュール ハジャー、約2カ月ぶりの実戦へ「初日から全力でいくのを楽しみにしている」レッドブルはローソンの貢献に感謝 レッドブルからの全幅の信頼を得たハジャー「これからもマックスと共にここで走れるのは光栄なこと」 レッドブル、ハジャーとの契約延長を発表。 [e003:f16] 2027年にフェルスタッペンとのペアが継続 ウイリアムズはバクーで大型アップデートも、代表は「ポイントを獲得できる位置に到達するには不十分」と改善を焦らず。

evidence.title: 717 hp Aston Martin DBX S launched in Singapore at $980,000
evidence.body: [e005:f01] Powering the Aston Martin DBX S is a twin-turbocharged V8 producing 717 hp and 900 Nm (664 lb-ft) of torque, making this the most powerful DBX Aston Martin has launched its most performance-focused luxury SUV in Singapore. [e005:f02] The new DBX S is now available to order, with prices starting at $980,000 before COE and options. [e005:f03] It can sprint from 0-100 km/h (0-62 mph) in 3.3 seconds and reach a top speed of 310 km/h (193 mph). [e005:f04] A specially tuned nine-speed wet-clutch automatic sends power through an all-wheel-drive system. [e005:f05] Aston Martin has also focused on shedding weight. [e005:f06] Optional 23-inch magnesium wheels and a carbon-fibre roof contribute to a potential 47 kg reduction. [e005:f07] Visually, the Aston Martin DBX S gets a more aggressive grille, a redesigned rear end and distinctive quad-stacked exhausts. [e005:f08] Carbon-fibre exterior elements are optional, while the cabin receives unique S-specific detailing. [e005:f09] For those wanting a closer look, Aston Martin currently has an Onyx Black example with a Phantom Grey interior available for viewing and test drives. [e005:f10] Customer deliveries are expected to begin in Q1 2027. [e005:f11] Source: SGCarMart。

evidence.body: [e009:f01] 来年１月から同チームの通信およびＥコマース領域における「チームパートナー」となり、F1マシンをはじめ、ドライバーのレーシングスーツやチームの活動拠点などに自社のブランドロゴを掲出する。 [e009:f02] Ｆ１は年間18億3000万人（2025年）の視聴者を集める世界最高峰のモータースポーツ。 [e009:f03] スクーデリア・フェラーリＨＰはイタリアの高級自動車メーカー・フェラーリが運営し、1950年にF１が始まって以来、唯一初年度から現在まで参戦し続けている。

evidence.title: George Russell issues Mercedes engine update amid FIA penalty reality
evidence.body: [e001:f01] George Russell issues Mercedes engine update as FIA penalty looms George Russell issues Mercedes engine update as FIA penalty looms Russell issues Mercedes engine update with FIA penalty implications Jamie Woodhouse 24 Sep 2026 7:10 AM George Russell will not take an engine grid penalty in Baku George Russell is facing an FIA grid penalty at some stage of F1 2026, with the Mercedes driver expected to take a new power unit. [e001:f02] Russell confirmed this would not happen at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix. [e001:f03] While Baku is a circuit that lends itself to overtaking opportunities, Russell doubled down on the view that Mercedes is waiting until its ADUO-upgraded engine comes online. [e001:f04] George Russell will not take Azerbaijan GP grid penalty Both Mercedes drivers, Russell and championship leader Kimi Antonelli, have suffered from reliability gremlins in F1 2026, despite the Silver Arrows controlling both championships. [e001:f05] Antonelli, who was forced to retire in Barcelona, served an engine penalty at Monza after exceeding his allocation of power unit components for the season. [e001:f06] Russell will ultimately suffer the same fate of an engine penalty, but that will not be happening in Baku. [e001:f07] “I will take a penalty slightly further down the line. [e001:f08] “This one is coming to the end of its life, let’s say, but it won’t be long until, unfortunately or fortunately, you’re taking the penalty because, depending where you do it, it cannot be so harmful.” On the face of it, the Baku City Circuit is one of those tracks where an engine penalty does not need to spell disaster. [e001:f09] Mercedes qualified to upgrade its internal combustion engine under the FIA’s ADUO [Additional Development and Upgrade Opportunities] concept, one which has Red Bull as the ICE benchmark. [e001:f10] Russell and Mercedes are waiting until that boosted ICE is available before triggering a grid penalty. [e001:f11] “Because we have the ADUO update coming,” Russell reiterated when asked why Mercedes is not taking the grid drop in Baku, “which means I would have had to have taken another penalty. [e001:f12] It’s all a bit complicated, but long story short, if I took one now, I would have had to have taken another one.” More on George Russell from FIA confirms Mercedes findings after ‘extensive’ George Russell inspection Toto Wolff makes Russell admission after Antonelli F1 2026 dominance Russell goes into the Azerbaijan GP 91 points behind Antonelli at the top of the standings . evidence.title: Aston Martin rivals don't want to sign Fernando Alonso
evidence.body: [e002:f01] Former F1 driver Marc Surer believes that Fernando Alonso will continue to race at Aston Martin next season, partly due to the fact that his options to drive elsewhere are limited. [e002:f02] With Max Verstappen having committed his long-term future to Red Bull last month, Alonso's next move is now the biggest unresolved piece of F1's 2026 silly season. [e002:f03] The two-time world champion turned 45 years old back in July and has been a very vocal critic of F1's current regulations, and his experience of them has no doubt been made even worse by Aston Martin's struggles. [e002:f04] F1 HEADLINES: Lewis Hamilton gets Ferrari boost as major rule change approved Marc Surer on Fernando Alonso 's F1 future Speaking after that tough outing for Alonso in Madrid, Surer, who competed in F1 between 1979 and 1986, offered his verdict on the experienced Spaniard's future in the sport and whether or not he will retire at the end of this year. [e002:f05] Surer believes that Alonso will remain in F1 with Aston Martin next season, not only because he still has the passion to keep racing, but also because he has no options to drive elsewhere. [e002:f06] "I think he loves racing still," Surer told GPFans . [e002:f07] "And I mean, there is hope that Aston Martin is going better next year, so I think he will extend his contract. [e002:f08] " Surer: Aston Martin desperate to keep Alonso Surer, ambassador for Lucky Rebel , added that Aston Martin are also desperate to keep hold of their star man, citing their poor car as the key reason they would not be able to sign anybody better. [e002:f09] "I think Aston Martin is desperate to keep him because at the moment, as the car is, they can’t get a better driver or a driver on the same level," Surer added. [e002:f10] Fernando Alonso is yet to announce a decision on his F1 future "They cannot because nobody wants to go to Aston Martin apart from the young drivers who want to come into Formula 1. [e002:f11] Despite just nine rounds of the season remaining, we still do not know when a decision is coming on Alonso's future. [e002:f12] "It's a matter of understanding what the rules from next year will have an impact or not on the racing and on the driving side of things," Alonso told the media when discussing his F1 future. [e002:f13] "The current cars, as I said many times, are not the best cars to drive and to enjoy. [e002:f14] But next year there is a step in the right direction, hopefully. [e002:f15] "At the same time, I need to think what is the best programme for next year and sit with the team.

evidence.title: FIA WEC Recreates a Scene from ‘Cars’ to Announce Le Mans-Winning Toyota’s Homecoming
evidence.body: [e004:f01] The short video pays tribute to the Toyota TR010, returning to Japan after its win in France back in June. [e004:f02] Toyota won the 24 Hours of Le Mans for the sixth time in June, but this victory was special. [e004:f03] After taking five overall wins effectively uncontested, 2026 marked the first time for the brand to claim glory against a full field of stiff competition. [e004:f04] The car that did it will be on hand for the upcoming FIA World Endurance Championship round at Fuji, and the series is celebrating with a video that seems to be paying tribute to a scene from, of all things, the movie not exactly a shot-for-shot remake—and the caption suggests an implied link to the Fast Furious franchise instead—the WEC video is a play on an early sequence from the first Cars movie. [e004:f05] In that scene, a truck is surrounded and lured to sleep by various modified cars to get Lightning McQueen lost and set off the (otherwise entirely unrelated) plot of the movie. [e004:f06] The scene naturally plays out differently here, with four modified Toyotas surrounding the TR010 in its transparent trailer while a GPS shows the truck en route to Fuji may not make much thematic sense, but the clip is a fun way to illustrate the TR010’s return to the Toyota-owned track. [e004:f07] The car should be visible to anyone attending the race at Fuji trackside this weekend, although there’s no word on whether or not the various modded Toyota road cars seen in the video will be there, the now-historically-significant Le Mans winner has become a museum piece, two other TR010s will be competing in the race as they continue Toyota’s pursuit of another WEC title. [e004:f08] Toyota has a seven-point lead over BMW in the manufacturer’s standings and its Le Mans-winning No. [e004:f09] 7 team is tied with the No. [e004:f10] 20 Team WRT BMW lineup at the top of the driver’s championship with just three races left to run on the season.

evidence.title: アステモ、新社長にホンダ四輪本部長の井上勝史氏 竹内弘平社長は退任 ホンダ四輪事業の立て直しを全面支援
evidence.body: [e008:f01] 6月25日の定時株主総会と7月1日の臨時取締役会を経て正式決定する。 [e008:f02] 井上氏はホンダの欧州や中国の責任者などを経て、電動事業開発部門のトップ、昨年4月には四輪事業本部長に就いたが、6月にホンダの取締役退任が決まっていた。 [e008:f03] ホンダは日立が保有するアステモの株式21％分を取得し、出資比率を61％に引き上げて子会社化する予定でいる。 [e008:f04] 電気自動車（EV）戦略の失敗で業績が悪化している同社は、ソフトウエア・デファインド・ビークル（SDV）やハイブリッド車（HV）に重点を置く方針に軌道修正した。 [e008:f05] アステモはSDVや電動車向けを含むパワートレイン技術に強い。 [e008:f06] ホンダはアステモの先進技術や開発力を高く評価しており、連携を強化する。 [e008:f07] 今回、ホンダの四輪事業部門で実務経験の長い井上氏にトップ交代することで、ホンダの四輪事業の立て直しについて、系列サプライヤーとして全面的に支える体制を整える。 [e008:f08] 竹内社長もホンダ出身で、2023年7月にアステモの社長に就いた。 [e008:f09] ホンダでは財務・管理部門が長く、アステモでは前任社長時代の品質問題を踏まえた対応や財務体質の改善、株式公開に向けた準備などを担ってきた。 [e008:f10] 井上勝史氏（いのうえ・かつし）1986年3月、横浜国立大学経営学部卒、同年4月ホンダ入社。 [e008:f11] 2015年ホンダカーズインディア社長、16年ホンダ執行役員、欧州地域本部長、20年常務執行役員兼中国本部長兼本田技研工業（中国）投資総経理兼本田技研科技（中国）総経理、23年執行役専務兼電動事業開発本部長、25年取締役執行役専務兼四輪事業本部長兼リスクマネジメントオフィサー、25年6月同取締役執行役専務、26年4月同取締役。

[e009:f09] プレリュードのコクピットを千代勝正と坪井翔がチェック！ [e009:f10] もっと見る フォーミュラ一騎打ち 勝負の最後はやっぱり『人間』 詳細を見る F速 Premium Vol.3 角田裕毅 現在・過去・未来 2,100円 商品ページ。

evidence.title: NASA and SpaceX Prepare Crew-13 for Launch to the International Space Station
evidence.body: [e002:f01] The mission will launch on a Falcon 9 rocket from NASA’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida, continuing the operational sequence of NASA’s Commercial Crew Program. [e002:f02] From left are, Commander Jessica Watkins and Pilot Luke Delaney, both from NASA, and Mission Specialists Joshua Kutryk of CSA (Canadian Space Agency) and Sergey Teteryatnikov of Roscosmos. [e002:f03] NASA But Crew-13 carries an additional historical significance. [e002:f04] Its official mission patch includes a tribute to Apollo 13, the 1970 lunar mission that became one of the most dramatic examples of engineering, teamwork and survival in the history of human spaceflight. [e002:f05] More than five decades after Apollo 13, NASA is once again flying a crewed mission designated with the number 13 — this time without changing the designation or avoiding the number. [e002:f06] Rather than treating 13 as a warning sign, the Crew-13 emblem uses the legacy of Apollo 13 as a reminder of how engineering and human ingenuity can overcome extraordinary circumstances. [e002:f07] The legacy of Apollo 13 The association between NASA and the number 13 became particularly strong in April 1970. [e002:f08] Two days later, on April 13, an oxygen tank in the spacecraft’s Service Module exploded, severely damaging the vehicle and forcing NASA to abandon the planned lunar landing. [e002:f09] Although Apollo 13 failed to achieve its planned lunar landing, NASA ultimately regarded the mission as a remarkable demonstration of engineering capability and crisis management. [e002:f10] When NASA briefly avoided the number 13 The space agency’s relationship with the number 13 became more complicated during the Space Shuttle era. [e002:f11] After the first shuttle missions were designated sequentially as STS-1, STS-2 and so on, NASA introduced a different naming system in the early 1980s. [e002:f12] The new system incorporated elements such as the fiscal year, launch site and mission sequence. [e002:f13] One of the most memorable responses came from the crew of STS-41-C, which launched in April 1984. [e002:f14] SpaceX’s crewed Dragon missions began with the Demo-2 test flight in 2020, followed by the operational Crew-1 mission and subsequent flights. [e002:f15] Crew-13 therefore represents more than another entry in the launch manifest. [e002:f16] For engineers, flight controllers and astronauts, the critical factors remain the same: propulsion performance, trajectory calculations, spacecraft systems, redundancy, weather conditions, communications and continuous monitoring of the vehicle.

Exolaunch signs SpaceX contract for 2029 Starfall mission
evidence.body: [e003:f01] Under the agreement, Exolaunch will serve as a payload integrator for the mission, providing customers with an end-to-end pathway to send experiments and other mission-critical payloads into space, operate them in a microgravity environment and return them safely to Earth. [e003:f02] The company plans to make the service available to biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies, advanced-materials developers, governments, space agencies, research institutions and private organizations seeking access to microgravity. [e003:f03] Jeanne Allarie, Chief Marketing Officer at Exolaunch, said: “Today, Exolaunch is opening an entirely new chapter in its history. [e003:f04] We are proud to secure our first Starfall mission with SpaceX. [e003:f05] For years, we have helped satellite operators around the world reach orbit reliably and at scale. [e003:f06] Through this new program, we are extending that trusted model to microgravity research, in-space manufacturing, and return-to-Earth services. [e003:f07] Exolaunch looks forward to bringing its integration experience, global customer network and record of execution to this next generation of missions.” Demand for microgravity-based research is increasing across several sectors, particularly pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, life sciences and advanced materials. [e003:f08] Potential applications include semiconductor materials research, crystal growth and optical-fiber manufacturing. [e003:f09] Exolaunch said its Starfall mission is intended to broaden access to these capabilities by aggregating customer demand and managing the technical, contractual, logistical and operational requirements associated with flying payloads in space. [e003:f10] Emilie Marley Siemssen, Vice President of Business Development at Exolaunch, added: “SpaceX’s Starfall spacecraft presents an opportunity to expand access to microgravity. [e003:f11] The ability to launch, operate and return payloads through a single integrated service is transformative.” The new agreement builds on Exolaunch’s existing relationship with SpaceX. [e003:f12] Since 2020, the company has supported the deployment of hundreds of customer satellites across dozens of Falcon missions, serving commercial operators, governments, universities, research organisations and space agencies. [e003:f13] Exolaunch is now working with customers and strategic partners for the planned 2029 mission. [e003:f14] The Starfall agreement follows Exolaunch’s recently announced Exo-1 and Exo-2 missions, which are scheduled to launch on SpaceX’s Falcon 9 rocket. [e003:f15] The developments also come as EQT Private Equity continues its acquisition of Exolaunch. [e003:f16] Together, the new missions and investment are expected to support the company’s international expansion and the development of additional services across the space value chain.

evidence.title: SpaceX Hits 700 Falcon Launches as NASA Adds $946 Million and Starship Waits in the Wings
evidence.body: [e004:f01] While attention fixates on the launch pads of Texas — where the Super Heavy booster B21 rolled out to Pad 2 overnight into Monday — the more telling gauge of SpaceX's economic health sits elsewhere. [e004:f02] The company's market valuation stands at EUR 134.28 per share, up 1.4%, yet the real story lies beneath the spectacle of heavy-lift test preparations: an operating engine whose reliability has few peers in the industry. [e004:f03] Media reports indicate SpaceX is targeting no earlier than September 28 for Starship's 14th orbital test flight, following a postponement on Thursday. [e004:f04] A Milestone Above the Atmosphere On September 13, the company notched a landmark: with the launch of the final three O3b mPOWER satellites for SES, the 700th Falcon rocket lifted off. [e004:f05] Another 27 Starlink V2 Mini satellites reached orbit on Saturday, reinforcing a cadence that is no theoretical promise but lived reality — and, in this view, evidence of the operational dominance SpaceX has built over traditional competitors. [e004:f06] On Friday, NASA expanded an existing framework agreement with SpaceX by $946 million, covering three additional crewed missions to the International Space Station designated Crew-15, Crew-16 and Crew-17. [e004:f07] An order book of that scale underscores how indispensable SpaceX has become to the U.S. space agency, securing predictable cash flows that in turn fund the costly development of the next launch vehicle generation. [e004:f08] SpaceX embodies this balancing act between state security infrastructure and the aggressive scaling of a globe-spanning satellite network — a business model that must reconcile military secrecy and civilian mass production under one roof. [e004:f09] The mission's design illustrates the evolutionary leap: mid-September, the company announced it would aim for a roughly ten-hour flight at an altitude of about 275 kilometers, spanning approximately six Earth orbits, followed by a controlled descent in the Pacific Ocean west of Chile. [e004:f10] This is no longer merely about leaving the atmosphere — the focus is on the logistical capability to deploy heavy payloads precisely and return the launch system under control. [e004:f11] Valuation Leaves Little Room for Error This two-track approach — reliable state contractor and risk-taking fleet operator — shapes how the capital market sees the company. [e004:f12] Such a valuation no longer reflects only the imagination of a pioneer; it mirrors the expectation that SpaceX can permanently convert its dominant position in orbital transport into operating profitability. [e004:f13] With a valuation that leaves little room for operational missteps, investor expectations for the future Starship system are enormous — after all, the vehicle is meant to carry larger payloads such as the planned V3 Starlink satellites. [e004:f14] The danger lies primarily in delays during the generational change of rocket systems, not in the existing business model. [e004:f15] As long as the core business delivers returns this smoothly, SpaceX can afford the patience required on the road to its next technological leap — a combination of profitable Falcon missions, long-term government contracts and the rapid build-out of the Starlink fleet that argues for a persistently strong market position. [e004:f16] Ad SpaceX Stock: New Analysis - 22 September Fresh SpaceX information released.

evidence.title: アジア初契約！ KDDIとSpaceX、次世代衛星「Starlink Mobile V2」で圏外エリアの高速通信目指す
evidence.body: [e005:f01] KDDI株式会社は9月15日、衛星とスマートフォンの直接通信サービス「au Starlink Direct」において、Space Exploration Technologies Corp.（SpaceX）との間で次世代衛星「Starlink Mobile V2」のサービス提供契約を8月10日に締結したと発表しました。 [e005:f02] 同社によると、この契約はアジアで初めての事例となるとのことです。 [e005:f03] 目次 圏外エリアでも高速通信と音声通話を目指す 今回の契約は、圏外エリアでの高速データ通信と音声通話の提供を目的としたものです。 [e005:f04] これまでの「au Starlink Direct」はメッセージ送受信や対応アプリによるデータ通信が中心でしたが、日常利用に近いブロードバンド通信と音声通話（VoLTE）の提供を2027年内に目指すとのことです。 [e005:f05] 次世代衛星「Starlink Mobile V2」の性能 次世代衛星「Starlink Mobile V2」は、第1世代の衛星と比較してアンテナサイズが拡大されています。 [e005:f06] 同社の発表によると、衛星1基あたり約20倍のスループットを実現するとともに、より多数の通信ビームを活用することで約100倍のデータ密度を実現し、通信性能が大幅に向上するということです。 [e005:f07] KDDIはこの契約を通じて、圏外エリアにおける通信手段をさらに拡充する方針を示しています。 [e005:f08] KDDIとSpaceXのこれまでの取り組み KDDIとSpaceXは、2021年の「Starlink」導入に向けた業務提携以降、au基地局のバックホール回線にStarlinkを採用したほか、法人・自治体向け「Starlink Business」の国内初提供を行ってきました。 [e005:f09] 災害発生時にはStarlinkを無償提供し、避難所における通信復旧にも取り組んできたとのことです。 [e005:f10] 2025年4月からは「au Starlink Direct」の提供を開始しており、2026年には海外ローミング接続や、SOS発信による緊急時の救助要請への対応、IoTデバイスやAIドローンとの直接通信などにも活用領域を広げているとのことです。 [e005:f11] これまでの主な取り組み Starlinkとの業務提携（2021年9月13日） 法人・自治体向け「Starlink Business」提供（2022年10月12日） au通信網でのStarlink利用開始（2022年12月1日） 能登半島の避難所にStarlink350台を無償提供（2024年1月7日） 「au Starlink Direct」提供開始（2025年4月10日） 世界初の海外ローミング接続開始（2026年3月4日） 「au Starlink Direct SOSセンター」新設（2026年4月23日） 「au Starlink Direct」のIoT接続（国内初、2026年4月23日） 圏外エリアでの衛星直接通信ドローン飛行実証成功（2026年7月22日） 両社の代表者がコメント SpaceXのPresident and COOを務めるGwynne Shotwellさんは、次世代Starlink Mobile V2を通じてKDDIとともに日本の利用者へ強靭でシームレスな通信体験を届けられることを喜ばしく思うとコメントしています。 [e005:f12] 同氏は、両社の強みを掛け合わせることで、場所や環境に左右されずに多くの人がつながる世界を実現していきたいとも述べています。 [e005:f13] KDDI代表取締役社長CEOの松田浩路さんは、SpaceXの拠点であるテキサス州Starbaseを訪れ、Shotwellさんと今後の構想について意見を交わしたことを明らかにしています。 [e005:f14] 松田さんは、Starlink Mobile V2をはじめとする今回の取り組みが、KDDIが掲げる「AI前提社会を支える次世代インフラ構想」と重なるものだとした上で、今後もつながる力の進化に取り組んでいく考えを示しました。 [e005:f15] 詳細は KDDIニュースルーム で案内されています。 [e005:f16] KDDIニュースルーム： https:// ニュース Starlink Mobile V2 目次。
